 LOCAL MATTERS. GET LOCAL Go ad-free High school sports Local events Obituaries News Social Security today: Who gets paid Wednesday, Nov. 18?
 Social Security’s regular Wednesday payment group for birth dates from the 11th through the 20th is scheduled for Nov. 18. A separate account deadline that day concerns online COLA notices, while the 2027 Social Security increase begins with January benefits.
 Staff Report November 17, 2026 · 5:00 am Social Security beneficiaries on the regular Wednesday cycle for birth dates from the 11th through the 20th are scheduled for payment Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. The date follows the third-Wednesday rule in the Social Security Administration’s 2026 payment calendar .
 For readers checking on Tuesday, Nov. 17, that payment is tomorrow. It applies to that birth-date group, rather than everyone receiving Social Security, and does not mark the start of the 2027 cost-of-living increase.
 Who is scheduled for Nov. 18 and Nov. 25?
 The two remaining Wednesday dates in November serve different birth-date groups under the ordinary monthly cycle:
 Scheduled payment date Worker’s birth-date group 
 Wednesday, Nov. 18 11th through 20th of any month 
 Wednesday, Nov. 25 21st through 31st of any month 
 The birthday used is that of the person whose work record supports the benefit, as SSA’s payment-day rules explain . For benefits paid on a spouse’s record, that can be the spouse’s birthday.
 People who were receiving or had applied for Social Security on or before April 30, 1997, or receive both Social Security and Supplemental Security Income follow a separate schedule. Social Security is usually paid on the third and SSI on the first. They should check the official calendar for their dates instead of using the Wednesday birthday table.

 A separate deadline falls on the same day. SSA’s COLA information page says beneficiaries must have created a personal my Social Security account by Nov. 18 for online access to their COLA notice, available to most beneficiaries in late November. That account deadline concerns the notice, not eligibility for tomorrow’s scheduled payment or the benefit increase.
 The 3.6% adjustment begins with Social Security benefits payable in January 2027. Increased SSI payments begin Dec. 31, 2026. FingerLakes1 previously explained the Nov. 18 online-notice deadline and when the increase takes effect .
 The U.S. Social Security Administration’s April 16, 2025 video introduces personal my Social Security accounts.
 What if a scheduled payment does not arrive?
 For an electronic payment that does not arrive on its scheduled date, SSA advises contacting the bank or financial institution first because posting may be delayed. If the payment still needs to be reported as missing, call Social Security at 800-772-1213 (TTY: 800-325-0778) or contact a local SSA office.
